facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya cites national KE-CIRT/CC statistics and a National Cyber Security Agency with a board chair, as national cyber bodies.
The Communications Authority says it issued more than 20 million cybersecurity advisories between July and September 2026.
National KE-CIRT/CC statistics show about 2.6 billion cyber threat events detected July-September 2026, up 14.45 per cent on the previous quarter.
The NCSA board chair cited the Computer Misuse and Cybercrime Act, 2018 as a pillar of Kenya's legal framework.
The NCSA board chair cited the Data Protection Act, 2019 as a pillar of Kenya's legal framework.
